# @tpvpn/tokens — build output

Generated by @tpvpn/tokens — do not edit. Source of truth: `packages/tokens/src/**/*.json` (W3C DTCG) → `node build.mjs`.
505 tokens, Light mode only. Naming: `color.bg.canvas` → CSS `--tp-color-bg-canvas` → Tailwind `--color-bg-canvas` → Dart/Swift/Kotlin `colorBgCanvas`.

| File | Platform | How to consume |
|---|---|---|
| `css/tokens.css` | Any web | `@import '@tpvpn/tokens/css';` — every token as `--tp-*` on `:root`. Typography roles are split into `-font-family/-font-size/-line-height/-font-weight/-letter-spacing`. |
| `tailwind/theme.css` | Tailwind CSS v4 | `@import 'tailwindcss'; @import '@tpvpn/tokens/tailwind';` — gives `bg-bg-canvas`, `text-fg-primary`, `bg-action-primary-bg`, `text-body`, `rounded-lg`, `shadow-level-2`, `ease-standard`, `h-control-md`, `max-w-content`. Gradients, z-index, opacity and component tokens sit in a plain `:root` block as `--gradient-*`, `--z-index-*`, `--opacity-*`, `--tp-*`. |
| `json/tokens.json` | Any (nested) | `import tokens from '@tpvpn/tokens'` — resolved tree keeping `$type`/`$description`. |
| `json/tokens.flat.json` | Any (flat) | `import flat from '@tpvpn/tokens/flat'` — `flat['color.bg.canvas'] = { value, type, description, original }`; `original` is the source reference (e.g. `{color.slate.25}`) or raw value. |
| `dart/tp_tokens.dart` | Flutter | Copy into `lib/core/theme/` (or add the package path). `TpTokens.colorBgCanvas`, `TpTokens.radiusMd`, `TpTokens.typographyBody` (`TextStyle`), `TpTokens.elevationLevel2` (`List<BoxShadow>`), `TpTokens.durationBase`, `TpTokens.easingStandard` (`Cubic`). Gradients are listed as comments — build them with `LinearGradient`. |
| `swift/TPTokens.swift` | iOS / UIKit | Add the file to your target. `TPTokens.colorBgCanvas` (`UIColor`), `TPTokens.radiusMd` (`CGFloat`), `TPTokens.typographyBody` (`TPTextStyle` → `.font`), `TPTokens.elevationLevel2` (`[TPShadow]`, use `layerRadius` for `CALayer.shadowRadius`), `TPTokens.durationBase` (seconds), `TPTokens.easingStandard` (control points). |
| `kotlin/TpTokens.kt` | Android / Jetpack Compose | Drop into `com.tpvpn.design`. `TpTokens.colorBgCanvas` (`Color`), `TpTokens.radiusMd` (`Dp`), `TpTokens.typographyBody.toTextStyle()`, `TpTokens.elevationLevel2` (`List<TpShadow>`), `TpTokens.durationBase` (ms), `TpTokens.easingStandard` → `CubicBezierEasing(a, b, c, d)`. |
| `android/values/colors.xml`, `dimens.xml` | Android Views / XML | Copy into `res/values/`. `@color/tp_color_bg_canvas` (ARGB), `@dimen/tp_radius_md` (dp), font sizes and line heights in sp, em letter-spacing as float items. |
| `figma/tokens.json` | Figma (Tokens Studio) | Tokens Studio → Settings → Sync → *Local file / JSON* → import this file (single set `global`). References such as `{color.blue.500}` are resolved by the plugin; then *Export to Figma → Variables* to create Figma Variables and styles. |

Rebuild after editing any source file: `pnpm --filter @tpvpn/tokens build`. Never edit files in `dist/` by hand.
